shell_commands: /bin/zsh -lc 'git status --short --branch; cat scripts/lore-descriptors.test.ts; cat scripts/lore-descriptors.*js; cat .lore/test-commands.yml; cat package.json'
/bin/zsh -lc 'cat jest.config.js; cat specs/lore-test-descriptors/spec.md; cat scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs; git log -3 --oneline; ls scripts/spec-links'
/bin/zsh -lc 'cat scripts/verify-script.test.ts | head -60; cat tsconfig.json; git show --stat --oneline 66795d5'

/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
p='.lore/dod.md'
s=open(p).read().replace('- [x] Expose stamped spec anchors in Jest test descriptors; the current list command omits the "'`spec` field.'"', '- [x] Expose stamped spec anchors in Jest test descriptors; the current list command omits the "'`spec` field.'"\\n- [x] Repair descriptor test lint findings by exercising the real module with one assertion.')
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
npx prettier --write scripts/lore-descriptors.test.ts .lore/dod.md
git diff --check
git diff"

/bin/zsh -lc "git add .lore/dod.md scripts/lore-descriptors.test.ts && git commit -m 'Fix descriptor test lint findings' && git push origin HEAD && git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status --short --branch"
